_comment: DCA dip-buy target ladder + per-alert tranche sizing. Kept in sync with TradingView alerts. direction 'below' = trigger when price <= target. buyNow = tranche to buy when the alert first fires; buyDeeper = second tranche on a further ~3-4% dip (averaging-in). yahooSymbol fetches the live price for the daily distance-to-trigger readout. Edit levels/sizes here → they update in the next briefing. Sizing per Ledger 2026-08-05 against live cash (CASH_USD $19,517 + CASH_THB ~$17,264).

budget.note: GOLDEN DE-CONFLICT RULE (Fable-validated 2026-08-18): the USD dip-ladder and the baht monthly DCA buy DISJOINT tickers. The baht DCA (SET50/US500/VEA/NDQ100) is the de-THB engine — runs on monthly cadence NO MATTER WHAT, never accelerates on a dip. The USD ladder (VOO/LLY/UBER/GLDM + one-shot SMH) only drains idle CASH_USD, once per dip. S&P: a VOO≤705 dip fires the USD VOO tranche ONLY — do NOT also add baht US500 on the same dip. VEA lives on the baht sleeve ONLY (USD-ladder VEA retired) because it only de-THBs when baht-funded. GULF FROZEN at ฿52,200 (bought 800@฿65.50 08-18, over the ฿40k cap and above the dead ฿56 trigger — a chase; accept as final, NO adds, ฿56 trigger deleted). Failure mode to police: reacting to the tape and double-committing to the same exposure. | FINALIZED 2026-08-14 (Thai-citizen; NO US W-2/401k framing — SET cap gains tax-free). Book rebuilt after BLS→DIME switch. THREE cash pots: CASH_THB ฿516,383 (DIME Thai pool, incl. GULF sale proceeds), SAVINGS_THB ฿500k (deploy ฿400k global, keep ฿100k buffer), CASH_USD $19,517 (US ETF ladder). THE SPLIT on the ฿516k DIME pool: ฿200k SET50 (Thai slice) + up to ฿40k optional GULF (≤฿56) + ฿276k REDIRECTED to global. So of ฿916k deployable baht → ~฿676k GLOBAL / ~฿240k THAI (decisive de-THB, per desk consensus + Neil's own 'Thai large-caps are dead money' realization). WHY: single-name Thai picking dropped — SET50 index covers the Thai slice; growth/capital-appreciation money goes global where it actually compounds. FINALIZED all-on-DIME (2026-08-17): consolidate everything on DIME (KKP Dime) for one-place monitoring; distribute at ฿10M. TOTAL GLOBAL ฿676k via DIME: KKP US500-UH-E (unhedged S&P, 0% mgmt fee) ฿400k / VEA ETF (unhedged developed ex-US, added per Neil 08-17) ฿180k / KKP NDQ100-UH-E (unhedged Nasdaq, 0% mgmt) ฿96k. SET50 core via TDEX ฿200k on DIME. Auto-DCA ~฿175k/mo × 5mo, debits from Dime Save. NOTE: 'Dime Silver Club' was a misremember — it's Dime! Club L1/2/3, existing holdings count; qualify by holding a fund+token gold+live DCA; benefit is modest trade-fee waivers, do NOT distort the plan for it. Dime Save pays ~1% above ฿10k so the ฿100k buffer stays in KBank. DCA ~monthly over 4-5mo. DROPPED SCBWORLD (hedged + triple-counts US). DE-CONFLICT: THB feeders vs USD ETF ladder hit SAME exposures — never fire both on one dip. Measure de-risk on TRUE Thai-home exposure (target ~40%), not THB denomination. RETIRED single-name entries (MINT/HMPRO/SCB sold; CBG/COM7/BH/KBANK folded into SET50).

targets.note: THE ONLY THAI EQUITY HOLDING. Single-name Thai stock-picking DROPPED 2026-08-14: Thai large-caps (BDMS, BH, the banks) have been range-bound/dead-money for ~8yr (SET topped ~1,800 in early 2018, below it for 6+yr) — no edge in picking one, and it stacks risk. SET50 index holds KBANK+GULF+BDMS+BH+AOT+PTT+CPALL+43 more passively, so it covers the healthcare slot (BDMS/BH) and the bank/energy exposure without single-name risk. Buy K-SET50 (KAsset, since 2005, ฿6.3bn AUM, 0.64%) — chosen over cheaper Principal SET50-E (฿324m, too small) per fund due-diligence. Alt: SCBSET50 (SCBAM, ฿5.15bn) or TDEX ETF on DIME (One AM, since 2007, ฿4.2bn, ~0.51% — mind spread). yahooSymbol ^SET50.BK is the live SET50 index (now tracked in macro-asset-monitor too).
